body.name: Graph-generated exact mixing domain \(\mathcal D_G\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal D_G=\{C\in\mathbb R^{n\times N}:\operatorname{rank}(C)=n;\; \operatorname{rank}M_j(C)=\operatorname{rank}[M_j(C),u_j(C)]\; \forall j;\; \operatorname{rank}C_{:,\operatorname{ch}_G(j)\setminus\{k\}}=\operatorname{rank}M_j(C)\text{ or }\operatorname{rank}[C_{:,\operatorname{ch}_G(j)\setminus\{k\}},u_j(C)]>\operatorname{rank}C_{:,\operatorname{ch}_G(j)\setminus\{k\}}\; \forall j,\; k\in\operatorname{ch}_G(j);\; \dim(\sum_{j\in J}W_j(C))\ge|J|\; \forall J\subseteq L;\; \det(C_{S,S})\ne0\; \forall S\in\mathcal I\}\).
